subject: computationally intensive app runs on laptop in 2 mins but takes 20 mins on Virtual machine

messages.author: 7c0cff8ab54518d3
messages.subject: computationally intensive app runs on laptop in 2 mins but takes 20 mins on Virtual machine
parts:
Hello All, 

I have developed a computationally intensive shiny app. The process runs on my local laptop ( 32 GB RAN, core i-7 2.90 GHx, 4 core, 8 processors, 1 TB SSD) in about 2 mins but the same process takes about 20 minutes when hosted as a virtualized server instance from the CentOS Virtual Machine in my universities DMZ network ( 32 GB total memory, x86_64, 8 CPUs, 1 thread per core, 4 cores per socket, 2 sockets with one web process per shiny application). 

I am trying to understand what could cause the huge discrepancy in the processing time on the two machines. 

Any help in this regard is greatly appreciated. 

Regards,
M
